frontmatter.title: WuppyCMS — the file-based CMS for Astro
frontmatter.description: WuppyCMS adds an admin panel to your Astro site. Content stays in Markdown files, every save is a Git commit, and editors get a visual editor.
frontmatter.headline: Your Astro site, with an admin your clients can use.
frontmatter.lead: WuppyCMS keeps content in Markdown and MDX files in your repository. Editors work in a clean admin with a visual editor; you keep plain files, Git history and your own Astro code.
frontmatter.featuresTitle: Everything a site needs, nothing it does not own
frontmatter.ctaTitle: Try WuppyCMS on your next Astro site
frontmatter.ctaText: Start with the guides, or try the demo.
